alate: 有翅成虫头宽连复眼约一点二五毫米，前胸背板宽零点九零至一点零四毫米。
book_name: 扬子江近扭白蚁 Pericapritermes jangtsekiangensis
distribution: 四川、河南、安徽、江苏、浙江、湖北、湖南、江西、贵州、福建、台湾、云南、广东与广西。
en: Soldiers are orange-yellow to deep orange-red and almost glabrous apart from a few setae on the anterior labral margin. The head is rectangular with subparallel sides, its posterior corners and hind margin forming an arc, and a conspicuous brown midline extending forward about a quarter of the length. The left mandible is strongly twisted, obliquely cut and blunt at the apex, the right shorter and sword-shaped. The labrum is longer than wide with a straight anterior margin and shortly pointed corners. Antennae are 14-segmented, and the saddle-shaped pronotum is narrower than the head, its front half tilted upright.
soldier: 头部橙黄或深橘红。除上唇前缘生有数根刚毛外，全体几乎无毛。头呈长方形，两侧略平行，两后侧缘与后缘合成弧形；头壳中线的褐色十分显眼，向前可伸达约四分之一处。左上颚强烈扭曲，其前方右侧斜切，末端钝；右上颚稍短，形如刀剑。上唇长大于宽，前缘平直，前侧角成短尖状。触角十四节。前胸背板窄于头，前半部直立上翘，为典型的马鞍状。
taxonomy_note: 原书记作扬子江近扭白蚁 Pericapritermes jangtsekiangensis，现按异名并入新渡户近扭白蚁 P. nitobei。
